facts.text: Serve the wine when Brennan moves in and the two of them meet for the first time.
facts.why: The Catalina Wine Mixer is near the end, when Brennan runs the event and he and Dale perform. Their first meeting is when Nancy and Robert marry and the two have to live together, with no wine.
facts.fix: Serve the wine when Brennan runs the Catalina Wine Mixer and the two of them take the stage.

facts.text: Brennan wants the bigger plate tonight. I made the dip myself, so you have to say it's good.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Brennan's real line at the first dinner is 'It's my fancy sauce.' (the ketchup and mayo he won't share).

facts.text: Bunk beds in the spare room
facts.why: Brennan and Dale share one bedroom (Dale's room with the drum set). Brennan's line is 'extra space in our room', so the bunk beds go in their shared room, not a spare one.
facts.fix: Bunk beds in the shared bedroom

vibe.verdict: Catalina Wine Mixer and Prestige Worldwide are the right nods, but it is a plain invite and the first dinner is misdescribed.
